meta.name: Ochre Forge Milestone Relic
meta.description: Forged in the heart of The Enclave First Forge & Stormbreaker Concordance by the illustrious Ochre Toad, this milestone trophy resonates with the deeply buried Ochre Stratum. By grounding subterranean plasma with hyper-dense alloys, it channels excess energy back to the user, significantly easing the durability drain on tools while deep in the Brass Ledger Frontier.
